title: Experimental Red and Black Editorial Interface

analysis.title: Experimental Red and Black Editorial Interface
analysis.notes: The design combines a sparse off-white canvas with oversized black typography, vivid red-orange blocks, and sharply cropped fashion imagery. Its desktop and mobile compositions use strong framing, asymmetry, tiny navigation labels, and generous negative space to create an art-directed digital exhibition feel.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create an editorial fashion-art hero image of a masked figure wearing a structured red utility jacket, dark gloves, and a gray bucket hat, shown from the back and slightly cropped at the torso. Use stark studio lighting, a pale gray-white background, a vivid red horizontal rectangle behind the figure, deep black shadows, and a clean high-fashion experimental mood. Compose it for a minimalist digital landing page with generous negative space and sharp geometric contrast; no text, logos, or recognizable brands.
